name: Cows2021 date-grouped detector adaptation v1
scope: Development adaptation using public human annotations. Compare source-video predictions and the previously used Toros diagnostic; not independent-farm or PYNQ-Z2 validation.
source_weights: Official YOLO26n COCO checkpoint; fresh load per seed, not a continuation of old cow checkpoints
admission_rule: Use all development images that passed the locked data_admission_v1 rules and actual loader check. Record any quarantine; no split changes or score-based removals.
object_definition: Class0 cow body: axis-aligned envelope of the image-clipped published rotated cow polygon. Not a whole-animal or oriented-AP definition.
checkpoint_selection: Use final epoch10 last.pt for all3 seeds; archive best.pt separately. Freeze all3 checkpoint hashes before new source/Toros inference. Report every seed without selecting one on video counts.
preflight: Actual full image/label loader checks, then exactly2 finite real CUDA loss/backward/optimizer updates on admitted train images. Discard smoke weights. Start formal training from original official checkpoint.
training_record: Record effective args, initial state digest, actual batches, optimizer calls, per-epoch metrics, complete CSV, and all checkpoint hashes.

source_replay.history_rule: Decode sequentially from source0 and infer at original frame indices divisible by5; save only8912..10873, preserve original frame coordinates and existing counting rules.

Toros: Previously used479-frame30fps6-event diagnostic. Same tracking/ROI/matching rules; retain torso-vs-whole-animal reference limitation. No training or checkpoint selection using this clip.
comparison_scope: New source data, labels and chronology differ from earlier OpenCows runs. Report a development model comparison, not a pure data-volume or synthetic-data causal effect.
required_gates: all selected source image transfers complete and source hashes verified
Pillow and OpenCV full image decode in Slurm
same-decoder prior-image and cross-role duplication review
any dHash review cues inspected before training admission
actual Ultralytics loader agrees with all prepared float32 labels
preflight CUDA updates succeed and are discarded
all3 final checkpoints frozen before video inference
full trace, media and independent arithmetic review before report
forbidden: No new candidate-final image pixels, source/Toros pseudo-labels, raw-video training, count-selected seeds/checkpoints, inflated independent-test claims or server timings described as board performance.
